description: This file defines an abstract class 'StreamManager' used in Apache Spark's network server module to manage data streams, fetch chunks, handle stream opening, and track transfer states.

classes.name: StreamManager
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for managing data streams, fetching chunks, and handling stream lifecycle events within Spark's network layer.

methods.name: getChunk
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch a specific chunk of a stream by stream ID and chunk index.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens a stream for reading, returning a ManagedBuffer or null if not found.

methods.name: connectionTerminated
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a network channel is terminated.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Verifies if a client is authorized to access a specific stream.

methods.name: chunksBeingTransferred
methods.description: Returns the count of chunks currently in transfer.

methods.name: chunkBeingSent
methods.description: Marks the start of sending a chunk.

methods.name: streamBeingSent
methods.description: Marks the start of sending a stream.

methods.name: chunkSent
methods.description: Marks a chunk as successfully sent.

methods.name: streamSent
methods.description: Marks a stream as successfully sent.
